description.p: Mari is for long writing — novels, scripts, anything that runs to chapters. Your book is ordinary files in an ordinary folder on your own computer. No account, no subscription, nothing uploaded, and nothing that stops working if a company does.

Mark a paragraph the way you would on a printed draft: good, weak, cut, come back to this. The marks stay with the chapter and show in the margin, so the second read is a matter of looking rather than remembering.

When a passage needs rewriting, open it beside the original and work on both at once. What you cut goes to the drawer rather than nowhere, and you can take it back later if the book turns out to want it.

A map of the whole chapter down the side, marks and all
Notes on any passage, kept with the chapter rather than beside it
Opens and saves Word files, Markdown and plain text
English, Russian, German, Spanish and Chinese
Free, and the source is open
